verdict.rationale: The pack contains no evidence of official Typesense SDKs or client libraries for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, or any other language, and nothing on how current they are kept. The only nearby items are a 'Search UI Components' heading and community questions about UI-library compatibility, neither of which shows language SDK coverage. SDK coverage is a fair axis for a search engine, so missing evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
